text:
Nina: Starting Lucent Irrigation POC thread. They need streaming SDK examples (Python + Go), structured function_call -> event JSON, SAML SSO for console, and customer CMK for embeddings. Also asked for a quick cost estimate for ~9k steady QPS (burst x2).
Omar: I'll sketch the samples. Key points: reconnect/backoff in SDK, show how to validate function_call payload schema, and a small adapter that posts to their event intake.
Nina: They run EU primary, US DR. Sales asked whether Dedicated is mandatory. They prefer hosted if we can guarantee stable tail latency.
Omar: Recommend Dedicated for predictable tail latency at that QPS. Rough capacity: 3-6 A10 equiv depending on model size + prefix-caching. Will produce a ballpark numbers doc.
clippy-bot: Docs -> <https://redwood.example.com/docs/presales/dedicated-vs-hosted|Dedicated vs Hosted>
Omar: Tiny Python streaming snippet to include:
```python
from redwood import Stream
with Stream(model='rwd-small', region='eu') as s:
  for m in s.receive():
    if m.type=='function_call':
      payload = json.loads(m.payload)
      # validate schema and emit to event gateway
      emit(jsonschema.validate(payload))
```
Nina: Also confirm KMS options: can we use a CMK on Dedicated and envelope on Hosted?
Omar: Yes. Dedicated supports customer CMK; Hosted supports envelope encryption for enterprise accounts. I'll attach the presales KMS page.
Nina: Action items: Omar -> samples + cost ballpark by EOD. I'll collect their exact model prompt sizes and whether attachments will be inlined.
Omar: Note: advise signed-upload URLs for large images instead of embedding base64 in the structured output. Less token overhead and more reliable.
